Uí Dúnlainge.subject: Indian Cinema
Uí Dúnlainge.question: Fourteen Uí _____ kings (from whom descend the O'Toole family) were based at Mullaghmast/Máistín
Uí Dúnlainge.fact: These kings were progenitors of the most powerful branches of Uí Dunlainge in the following three centuries: Uí Dunchada, Uí Faelain and Uí Muiredaig. Fourteen Uí Muiredaig kings (from whom descend the O'Toole family) were based at Mullaghmast/Máistín.

Uí Dúnlainge.subject: Indian Cinema
Uí Dúnlainge.question: By the end of this remarkable run, the kingship of _____ was being rotated between seventh cousins
Uí Dúnlainge.fact: By the end of this remarkable run, the kingship of Leinster was being rotated between seventh cousins. After the death of the last Kildare-based King of Laighin, Murchad Mac Dunlainge in 1042, the Kingship of Leinster reverted to the Uí Ceinnselaig kindred based in the south-east of Leinster.
